architecture.summary: Probe tooling only: (1) script/spike/capacity-probe.ts and its helper modules under script/spike/capacity-probe/ probe the capacity and memory of a hosted tenant web service on Render (0.5c-512mb, then 1c-2g) with 1, 5, and 10 parallel MCP fetch and search calls, the Render metrics and events of each window, a disposable pages origin, WorkOS Staging fixtures, and a Staging OAuth resource; they reuse the SO-01c and SO-01d part two Render modules and the hosted-live test fixtures, with a dry-run mode, a reads-only preflight, and a client guard that touches only the thermus-spike-* services of the run and never the production service, also in metrics reads; knip lists the script as an entry point. Small changes in script/spike/render-tenant-lifecycle/ and script/spike/private-network-probe/ let the three Render probes share the step runner, the service create, and the cleanup reads, and let the create call take variables and a Docker command; the SO-01c and SO-01d part two dry-run outputs stay the same. (2) The cancellation check of #272, merged into this branch: script/spike/gateway-proxy-probe.ts gains a --protocol 2025-11-25 run with the new modules cancel-notification.ts, cancel-measure.ts, and wire-tap.ts under script/spike/gateway-proxy/, where a client pinned to 2025-11-25 cancels a call by notifications/cancelled through the local proxy and a 2026-07-28 client aborts the same call for the contrast; the default run and its output stay the same. The Slice 1 evidence record docs/implementation/self-onboarding-s1.md gains the section SO-01e: capacity and memory, with the measured runs and the D-15 recommendation, and the SO-01d subsection Cancellation by notifications/cancelled (2025-era clients); docs/implementation/self-onboarding-plan.md names them in the SO-01e and SO-05 tickets. No source, runtime, registry view, declaration, or deployment change.
